R1957.summary: Frederick II to his secretary Louis Michell in London: he agrees that the King of Sardinia will join the Austro-Spanish treaty, has learned that Vienna and St Petersburg plan to make Prince Charles of Lorraine King of Poland, and asks Michell to find out what London knows, how long the English ministry's pacific system will last, and to report to the King alone. The text is printed from the minute in the Politische Correspondenz, vol. 8 (1882), no. 5263.
R1957.en:
DECODE R1957 (the Hague copy of the intercepted cipher). Translates texts/R1957pc5263.md, the text printed from
the minute in Politische Correspondenz Friedrich's des Grossen 8 (1882), no. 5263, pp. 576-577. It is a
translation of the printed concept, not of a decipherment: the project's own decode of the cipher does not build
sentences (see NOTES). Translation: Claude (session of 14 Nov 2026).

5263. To Secretary Michell in London.

Berlin, 28 December 1751.

I have received your dispatch of the 14th of this month and am, like you, of the opinion that the matter of the King
of Sardinia entering as a contracting party into the treaty being negotiated at Madrid between the courts of Spain
and Vienna will not fail, although I am persuaded that General Wall predicts quite rightly on that.

system: Frederick II's cabinet code of 1751 to Michell: a numerical nomenclator, point-separated groups 2-6472, with homophones for common words, separate groups for endings and phrase groups.
